queue.title: Synthetic Unicode slug behavior
queue.objective: Implement toSlug(value): return a lowercase, hyphen-separated slug; normalize compatibility characters, preserve Unicode letters and digits, map ampersand to the word and, collapse separators, and return an empty string for blank input.
acceptanceCriteria: Convert ampersand to the word and; collapse repeated separators to one hyphen.
Preserve Unicode letters and digits after NFKC normalization.
Blank input returns an empty string.
The focused test passes without network access.

queue.title: Synthetic duration label behavior
queue.objective: Implement formatDuration(minutes) as a deterministic formatter for non-negative integer minutes. Use singular "minute" only for 1 and plural "minutes" for all other accepted values; reject invalid values with a TypeError.
acceptanceCriteria: Use singular minute only for exactly 1; use minutes for zero and all other accepted integer values.
Reject negative, fractional, string, and non-finite input with TypeError.
The focused test passes without network access.
